_meta.name: Inbound Lead-to-Demo Engine
_meta.description: Captures inbound leads (form/webhook + CRM history), validates and deduplicates them, scores fit/intent/need/data-quality against the ICP rubric, classifies them (sales-ready / nurture / low-fit / needs-review), routes to an owner under policy, and prepares approval-first personalized demo-booking outreach with full explainability and source transparency.

nodes.name: Capture & Validate Leads
nodes.description: Retrieve inbound leads from the form/webhook fixture, validate fields, deduplicate, and assess data quality

nodes.name: Qualify & Score Leads
nodes.description: Score fit/intent/need/data-quality against the ICP rubric, classify each lead, and set the CRM/outreach policy result

nodes.name: Verify Qualification & Enforce Policy
nodes.description: Independently validate the qualification output schema, enforce safety rules (low data quality -> needs_review, confidence gating), and gate downstream actions

nodes.name: Draft Demo Outreach & Attach XAI
nodes.description: For verified sales-ready leads, prepare personalized, approval-first demo-booking email drafts with source transparency and explainability metadata

nodes.name: Route Owners & Request CRM Writes
nodes.description: Route each lead to an owner role, propose non-destructive CRM create/update requests under policy, and record the outcome (no external sends)

nodes.name: Persist Attribution & Evidence
nodes.description: Save run metrics, classification counts, and UTM attribution to pattern memory for the dashboard and weekly brief
